description: Source code for a thermal monitoring class (CThermalMonitor) in the WPEFramework plugin namespace, providing methods to get/set core temperature thresholds, overtemp grace interval, and emitting temperature threshold change events.

classes.name: CThermalMonitor
classes.description: A class providing thermal monitoring functionalities such as retrieving core temperature, thresholds, and handling temperature events.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of CThermalMonitor.

methods.name: addEventObserver
methods.description: Adds an event observer for thermal events.

methods.name: removeEventObserver
methods.description: Removes an event observer for thermal events.

methods.name: getCoreTempThresholds
methods.description: Retrieves current temperature thresholds (high and critical).

methods.name: setCoreTempThresholds
methods.description: Sets new temperature thresholds (high and critical).

methods.name: getOvertempGraceInterval
methods.description: Retrieves the current overtemperature grace interval.

methods.name: setOvertempGraceInterval
methods.description: Sets a new overtemperature grace interval.

methods.name: emitTemperatureThresholdChange
methods.description: Emits an event indicating temperature threshold crossing.

methods.name: reportTemperatureThresholdChange
methods.description: Logs or reports a temperature threshold change event.
